sentences.text: The rode is everything between the anchor and the boat.
Most small boats use a length of chain at the anchor, which keeps the pull low along the bottom and resists chafe on rocks and shells, then nylon line, which stretches to absorb shock.
Scope is the ratio of rode let out to the distance from your bow to the bottom: the water depth plus the height of the bow above the water.
Five to one is the minimum and seven to one is preferred, with more in heavy weather.
In fifteen feet of water with a bow three feet high, seven to one means eighteen times seven, or one hundred twenty-six feet.
